design: The 141 stratum-fold certificates of the main pipeline (double nesting, risk percentile within campus and quarter, capped transfer gate), recomputed with the functions of 45_certification_corrected.py, read gate by gate; a simpler rule built from the data-sufficiency and prior-record-trace fail levels; and the top-decile lift of f^(-c) on each stratum in the campus c that the certificate S^(-c)_k did not use.

sample_size.note: the 141 stratum-folds are not independent: each stratum contributes up to nine folds that share eight of nine campuses

prespecified.definition: certify when the stratum is evaluable (>=10 positives, >=100 rows) in at least min_contexts certifying contexts, has at least min_events positives, and has a no-antecedent share below max_no_antecedent; a share over fewer than 30 extreme events counts as not failing

post_hoc_grid.label: post hoc: levels searched on the same certificates they are compared with
post_hoc_grid.selection: highest agreement over the 141 stratum-folds; ties broken by pooled agreement, then fold kappa, then fewest contexts and events

heldout_performance.definition: top-decile lift of f^(-c) on the rows of stratum k in campus c; a pair is evaluable with >= 10 positives and >= 100 rows; holds = lift >= 2
